environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) in us-east-1 VPC running the Flask monolith directly on port 8080. An Application Load Balancer forwards traffic on port 443 to the target group on port 8080. The ALB security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional listener rules, no IP-based restrictions. The EC2 instance security group allows inbound 8080/tcp from the ALB security group. CloudWatch logging enabled but no active alerting on 4xx response patterns.
